shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- routing ---\\n' && sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- app ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- traps ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && printf '\\n--- layout ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat src/main.tsx && cat src/App.tsx && npm install @gravity-ui/page-constructor'

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; node -e \"for (const p of ['@gravity-ui/uikit','@gravity-ui/page-constructor']) {const j=require('./node_modules/'+p+'/package.json'); console.log(p,j.version,j.peerDependencies||{});}\"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor | head; if [ -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/dist/docs/INDEX.md ]; then echo '--- INDEX ---'; sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/dist/docs/INDEX.md; else echo '--- README ---'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md; fi; printf '\\n--- rg local docs ---\\n'; rg -n \"Hero|Feature|Features|CTA|Button|PageConstructorProvider|Required setup|custom-blocks\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/{dist,build} -g '*.md' | head -160"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const f=require('fs');const d='node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks';for(const file of f.readdirSync(d).sort())console.log(file);\"; printf '\\n--- Banner ---\\n'; sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/Banner.md; printf '\\n--- Features? names ---\\n'; sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/Features.md; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/HeaderBlock.md; printf '\\n--- provider API ---\\n'; rg -n \"PageConstructorProvider|ThemeProvider|ui-kit|theme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs -g '*.md' | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- Hero ---'; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/Hero.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- ExtendedFeatures ---'; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- provider props ---'; sed -n '130,175p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- types exports ---'; rg -n \"interface (Hero|ExtendedFeatures|Banner)|type (Hero|ExtendedFeatures|Banner)\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.ts' | head -80; printf '%s\\n' '--- schemas ---'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/schema && rg -n \"hero-block|extended-features|banner-block\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/schema node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build -g '*.json' -g '*.d.ts' | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- Hero remainder ---'; sed -n '60,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/Hero.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- ExtendedFeatures ---'; sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- block models ---'; sed -n '145,190p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts; sed -n '210,230p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts; sed -n '485,515p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- page models ---'; rg -n \"interface PageData|type PageData|interface Block|blocks:\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models -g '*.d.ts' | head -50; cp \""'$(pwd)/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts" /tmp/pc-blocks.d.ts; printf '"'%s\\n' '--- exports/styles ---'; node -e \"const j=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json'); console.log(j.exports); console.log(j.dependencies); console.log(j.peerDependencies);\""

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles | head && rg -n \"PageConstructorProvider\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -20 && sed -n '1,25p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor.d.ts && npm ls sass --depth=0"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.d.ts && node_modules/.bin/rg -n \"styles.css|styles/styles.scss\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md | head -30 || true; rg -n \"page-constructor/styles\" README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md; ls node_modules | rg '("'^sass$)'"' || true"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"PageData|PageContent|ConstructorItem\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -80; printf '\\n--- ConstructorBlock union ---\\n'; rg -n \"ConstructorItem\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models -g '*.d.ts' | head -40; printf '\\n--- ConstructorItem source ---\\n'; rg -n -A35 -B5 \"type ConstructorItem|interface ConstructorItem\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models -g '*.d.ts' | head -100"
/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "''^export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/index.d.ts | head -80'

/bin/bash -lc "npm install -D sass && apply_patch <<'PATCH' *** Begin Patch *** Update File: src/main.tsx @@ import '@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/fonts.css'; import '@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css'; +import '@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/styles.scss'; *** End Patch PATCH apply_patch <<'PATCH' *** Begin Patch *** Update File: src/App.tsx @@ -// Implement the requested feature here (and may add sibling files). +import { + PageConstructor, + PageConstructorProvider, + type PageContent, +} from '@gravity-ui/page-constructor'; + +const content = { + blocks: [ + { + type: 'hero-block', + fullWidth: true, + overtitle: 'Team time tracking', + title: 'See where every team minute goes', + text: 'A compact workspace for tracking shared work, leave, and sessions without spreadsheet friction.', + }, + { + type: 'extended-features-block', + title: { + text: 'Built for focused teams', + }, + items: [ + { + title: 'Shared time views', + text: 'See workload and availability across the whole team in one compact view.', + }, + { + title: 'Fast weekly entries', + text: 'Log recurring activities with templates and quick weekly data entry.', + }, + { + title: 'Clear project totals', + text: 'Turn tracked minutes into simple totals you can review with confidence.', + }, + ], + }, + { + type: 'banner-block', + title: 'Start tracking time together', + subtitle: 'Create a shared workspace in a few clicks—no credit card required.', + button: { + text: 'Get started', + url: '#get-started', + theme: 'action', + }, + }, + ], +} satisfies PageContent; + export function App() { - return
{/* TODO: implement the requested component */}
; + return ( + + + + ); } *** End Patch PATCH"
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v apply_patch || find / -type f -name apply_patch 2>/dev/null | head -10; ls /usr/local/bin | rg patch || true'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export.*type Theme|enum Theme|type Theme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build typings node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' | head -40; rg -n \"theme=|theme: \\\"\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor -g '*.ts' -g '*.tsx' -g '*.d.ts' | head -40"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,25p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/common.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,30p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/styles.css; printf '\\n--- root ---\\n'; sed -n '1,50p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/root.scss; printf '\\n--- docs CSS import ---\\n'; rg -n \"styles.css|root.scss\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs -g '*.md' | head -40"
/bin/bash -lc 'for f in node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/*.scss; do echo =====$f; sed -n '"'1,35p' \""'$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la vite.config.* 2>/dev/null || true; rg -n "alias|postcss|css" vite.config.ts vite.config.js vite.config.mts 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat vite.config.ts'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/utils/url.js"
/bin/bash -lc "tail -25 vite.config.ts; sed -n '90,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '100,125p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '125,170p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short 2>/dev/null || true; printf '\\n--- App ---\\n'; nl -ba src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- main ---\\n'; nl -ba src/main.tsx; printf '\\n--- config ---\\n'; nl -ba vite.config.ts; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; cat package.json"
